primary.title: No more tax relief for importing gold, silver and platinum: What does it mean? Will buyers pay more?
primary.summary: The government has withdrawn the upfront IGST exemption for banks and nominated agencies importing precious metals. Since 1 April 2026, these imports have been subject to a 3% customs levy.
